name: The Levy Barracks
summary: Where the palace levy sleeps: reed mats on clay benches, spears racked on one wall and oxhide shields hung on the other.
description: The palace levy are farmers for most of the year and soldiers when told, and they sleep here in rows on clay benches spread with reed mats, eight to a room and all of them snoring. Their spears stand in racks along the north wall, bronze heads catching whatever light comes in, and their great figure-of-eight shields of oxhide hang on the south wall like drying laundry. A low table in the corner has a gaming board scratched into it and a set of knucklebones nobody has put away. Kit bags and the chest hold what little they own.
build: Shell: the kit's OuterBailey shell, 12.0 × 12.0 × 0.30 m slab, 0.50 m ochre plaster walls 3.60 m clear, 0.45 m mud-brick capstone band, an archway 2.60 × 2.59 m centred on every wall.

Sleeping benches: four clay benches 0.90 × 3.00 × 0.35 m against the east and west walls at x ±5.00, y ±3.50; a reed mat 0.80 × 2.90 × 0.03 m on each; a rolled kit bag 0.60 × 0.50 × 0.14 m at the north end of the two northern benches.

Spear racks: two on the north wall at x ±3.40, each two uprights 0.10 × 0.10 × 1.50 m and a rail 2.10 m at 1.71 m above ground; five spears per rack, ash shafts r 0.02 × 2.10 m with bronze heads 0.30 m, at 0.40 m spacing.
Shields: four figure-of-eight oxhide shields hung flat on the south wall at x ±3.00 and ±4.20, each two discs (r 0.35 m at 1.60 m, r 0.30 m at 2.20 m above ground), 0.06 m thick.
Water jars: two, 0.60 m tall, belly 0.36 m, at (±2.20, −5.00).
Gaming table (SE): cypress, 0.90 × 0.60 m, 0.50 m high, at (3.20, −3.00).
Kit chest (SW): cypress 1.00 × 0.60 × 0.55 m with a bronze-bound lid at (−3.20, −3.20).
Walls: plaster fallen away low down to the mud-brick in places (albedo only).
sockets: Archway ×4, centred on each wall: 2.60 × 2.59 m (OuterBailey), all open
Spear racks: where the levy arm themselves when the alarm goes up

materials.name: Mud-brick
materials.notes: Capstone band, bench clay, the kit bags.

gameplay: Eight levymen sleep here: the room wakes all at once, and arms from the racks.
The benches are low cover; the chest and table are in the open south half.
